title: Parmigiana di Melanzane (Layered Fried Aubergine with Tomato and Mozzarella)
summary: Aubergine slices salted, blotted and fried until browned, then layered with garlic and basil tomato sauce, mozzarella and oregano and baked at 200 °C until bubbling. Rested 10 min before cutting.
equipment: heavy cast-iron or deep frying pan

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt, for drawing out
neutral frying oil (sunflower, rapeseed or vegetable)
fresh basil leaves, plus extra to serve
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Salt the aubergine
steps.text: Lay the slices on the racks, sprinkle both sides lightly with salt and leave for 20 min, then blot very dry.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Meanwhile, warm the oil and garlic in the saucepan over medium heat until the garlic sizzles. Add the tomatoes and half the basil and simmer for 20-25 min until thick, then season with the salt.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Heat 1 cm oil in the frying pan to about 180 °C. Fry the slices in batches for 2-3 min per side until browned, and drain on kitchen paper. Heat the oven to 200 °C.

steps.title: Layer and bake
steps.text: Spread a thin layer of sauce in the dish, then layer aubergine, sauce, mozzarella, oregano and the rest of the basil, repeating and finishing with sauce and cheese. Bake for 25-30 min until bubbling and browned. Rest for 10 min before cutting and serve topped with basil.

tips: Drain the fried slices well, or the dish will be greasy.
Make it a day ahead; it slices more neatly once set.

Frying safety: use a heavy, deep pot no more than half full of oil, with a clip-on thermometer, and dry the food before it goes in. Never leave hot oil unattended. If the oil catches fire, turn off the heat and cover the pot with a metal lid or use a fire extinguisher; never use water.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days. Reheat covered at 180 °C until piping hot (74 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
